title: 第三章 特殊的任务第四章 大功臣 快龙
content_zh:
一路上林萧开展了自己的赚钱计划，不管遇上什么神奇宝贝都会战斗一次。
第一次战斗时，林萧毫不廉耻的让快龙将一只小拉达干倒在地，结果系统提示：“恭喜宿主获得第一次战斗的胜利，奖励金币一个。”
不提示还好，这下直接让林萧心都掉进了万丈深渊。
战斗胜利一次给一个金币，也就是说买一只小火龙都得战斗一千次，喷火龙是三千次，暴地龙和班吉拉都是一万次。。。。。想到这里林萧差点两眼一黑，吐出一口老血，至于再上有层次的三神鸟、三圣兽、超神兽之类的就别指望了，光想想就能让人头皮发麻。
还好系统并没有那么黑，随后不久快龙打倒大针蜂让林萧得到了六个金币，总体来说就是战胜的对手越强，获得的金币就越多。
本来林萧也抱着遇到好的野生神奇宝贝就收复的想法，不过看了系统对快龙的评价就熄灭了。
快龙：雄性
身高：3.03米，评价：中
体重：270公斤，评价：中
力量，评价：良
体力，评价：良
速度，评价：良
精神，评价：差
爆发力，评价：优
成长度：36，评价：极差
能力开发度：70，评价：良
综合评分：75分
而系统的快龙数据则是。
快龙：雄性
身高：5米，评价：优

体重：600公斤，评价：优
力量，评价：优
体力，评价：优
速度，评价：优
精神，评价：中
爆发力，评价：优
成长度：100，评价：完美
能力开发度：100，评价：完美
综合评分：97分
将快龙的的数据比较一下，林萧更加坚定了自己尽快赚金币买神奇宝贝的想法。要是让大木博士知道自己的快龙被体统给出这样的成绩恐怕会气得吐血。
一路上走走停停，等常磐市的轮廓出现在眼前时，林萧一共获得63个金币，这也是从真新镇到常磐市的路上人流量比较大，野生的神奇宝贝并不是很多。
至于像其他穿越党一样跟着小智一起看凤王，林萧觉得自己没有那种兴趣。
现在凤王对于林萧来说还是太遥远，就像走在大街上的各种美女一样，不论你怎么抛媚眼，怎么看，美女同样还是别人的，而不是你自己的，还不如趁这段时间多打几枚金币来的实在。
这感觉就像是自己变成了游戏里的玩家，而其他的神奇宝贝和训练家都成了各种怪和大小boss，等自己去将他们打倒，然后掉金币买装备，继续推更大的boss。。。。。。
来到神奇宝贝中心，将快龙交给乔伊恢复体力，林萧便在任务墙上查找有没有适合自己的任务。
不过很可惜，这些任务要么是时间耗得的太久，要么就是完成任务的钱太少，都被林萧一一否决了。
content_en:
Along the way, Lin Xiao launched his own money-making plan, and would fight no matter what Pokémon he encountered.
In the first battle, Lin Xiao shamelessly asked Kuailong to knock a small rat to the ground. As a result, the system prompted: "Congratulations to the host for winning the first battle, and a gold coin will be awarded."
It was okay not to prompt, but Lin Xiao's heart immediately fell into the abyss.
Each victory in the battle will give you one gold coin, which means you have to fight a thousand times to buy a Charmander, three thousand times for Charizard, and ten thousand times for both Tyrannosaurus and Bandera. . . . . Thinking of this, Lin Xiao almost blacked out and spit out a mouthful of old blood. As for the three divine birds, three holy beasts, super divine beasts and the like, don't expect it. Just thinking about it can make people's scalp numb.
Fortunately, the system was not that dark. Shortly afterwards, Kuailong defeated the Big Needle Bee and Lin Xiao got six gold coins. Generally speaking, the stronger the opponent he defeated, the more gold coins he got.
Originally, Lin Xiao had the idea of ​​​​taking back good wild Pokémon when he encountered them, but he gave up after seeing the system's evaluation of Kuailong.
Kuailosaurus: male
Height: 3.03 meters, rating: medium
Weight: 270 kg, rating: medium
Strength, rating: good
Physical strength, rating: good
Speed, rating: good
Spirit, rating: poor
Explosive power, evaluation: excellent
Growth: 36, rating: very poor
Ability development degree: 70, evaluation: good
Overall score: 75 points
The system's Kuailong data is.
Kuailosaurus: male
Height: 5 meters, evaluation: excellent
Weight: 600 kg, evaluation: excellent
Strength, rating: excellent
Physical strength, evaluation: excellent
Speed, rating: excellent
Spirit, rating: medium
Explosive power, evaluation: excellent
Growth: 100, rating: perfect
Ability development: 100, evaluation: perfect
Overall score: 97 points
Comparing Kuailong's data, Lin Xiao became more determined to earn gold coins as soon as possible to buy Pokémon. If Dr. Ohmu knew that his Kuailong was given such a result by the system, he would be so angry that he would vomit blood.
Stopping and stopping along the way, when the outline of Joban City appeared in front of him, Lin Xiao got a total of 63 gold coins. This was because the road from Zhenxin Town to Joban City had a relatively large flow of people, and there were not many wild Pokémon.
As for watching Phoenix King with Xiaozhi like other time-traveling parties, Lin Xiao felt that he didn't have that interest.
Now the Phoenix King is still too far away for Lin Xiao, just like the various beauties walking on the street. No matter how you wink or look at her, the beauty is still someone else's, not your own. It's better to use this time to get a few more gold coins.
It feels like you have become a player in the game, and other Pokémon and trainers have become various monsters and bosses, waiting for you to defeat them, then drop gold coins to buy equipment, and continue to push for bigger bosses. . . . . .
When he came to the Pokémon Center and handed the Dragon to Joey to recover his strength, Lin Xiao looked on the task wall to see if there were any tasks suitable for him.
However, it was a pity that these tasks either took too long or had too little money to complete the tasks, so they were all rejected by Lin Xiao one by one.
